key_insight: 3AM injects 3D-aware features from MUSt3R into SAM2 at training time via a lightweight Feature Merger, producing video object segmentation that is more consistent across large viewpoint changes without heavy 3D preprocessing.
problem_solved: Memory-based video segmentation (e.g., SAM2) fails under large viewpoint changes because it relies on appearance features; prior 3D-aware solutions need camera poses, depth maps, and expensive preprocessing.
method: Training-time augmentation: integrate multi-level 3D-aware features from MUSt3R into SAM2 to imbue geometric consistency.
Feature Merger: a lightweight fusion module that merges MUSt3R features with SAM2 representations (multi-level, low compute overhead).
Maintain SAM2 inference pipeline while improving robustness to viewpoint change, avoiding explicit pose/depth preprocessing.
impact: Provides a practical way to make off-the-shelf segmentation models robust to viewpoint changes with minimal added cost, enabling better video understanding in dynamic camera scenarios without expensive 3D data or pipelines.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing SAM2 baseline vs SAM2 + 3AM (MUSt3R features → Feature Merger → improved masks)

paper_title: 3AM: Segment Anything with Geometric Consistency in Videos
paper_authors: Yang-Che Sun, Cheng Sun, Chin-Yang Lin, Fu-En Yang, Min-Hung Chen
